title: Settings
currencyNote: The conversion is only for comparison — you always report a price in the store's currency, this just changes how it's displayed.
sourcesText: Prices and quality ratings are our own community data. Links to Open Food Facts follow the ODbL (Open Database License) — data is never copied, the app just links to the source.
